nina_cs: Verdant Bio (trial) requested Brazil peering + IPv6-only path + short HMAC header for a one-day demo on 2026-05-12. Need allowlist + burst QPS.

lucas_ops: Hosted API? Confirm CIDR and expected QPS.

nina_cs: Hosted. CIDR: 2001:db8:85a3::/32. Sustained 120 QPS, bursts to 450 for short periods. Window 08:00-20:00 BRT. Contact: paola@verdant.bio.

mohit_net: We can add IPv6 allowlist + edge HMAC check. HMAC key must be provided and rotated by customer. We'll validate header X-VB-SIGN HMAC-SHA256.

sara_pm: Renewal touchpoint in June; capture latency and satisfaction.

lucas_ops: Propose billing cap $2k for demo, enable prefix caching, and emergency throttle command.

mohit_net: Edge config snippet: ```allowlist_ipv6:["2001:db8:85a3::/32"] header_hmac:{header:"X-VB-SIGN",algo:"HMAC-SHA256",key_id:"vb-demo-2026-05"} rate:{sustained:120,burst:450}```

deploy-bot: Ticket CS-2401 created: "Verdant Bio IPv6 peering + HMAC demo". Owners: lucas_ops, mohit_net.

lucas_ops: Canary 5% 2h before demo, monitor p95 latency and errors, then ramp if green.

nina_cs: I'll send acceptance + consent and confirm key rotation schedule.

mohit_net: After demo we'll rotate key to invalidate and remove allowlist. I'll export usage for billing.

sara_pm: I'll attach a 6-check eval (latency p50/p95, token-cost, routing correctness, HMAC failures, error spikes, NPS).

lucas_ops: Adding runbook command: `rb throttle cs-2401 --qps 50`. Tag on-call.

nina_cs: Closing loop 7: keys and consent into CS-2401, then proceed with canary. Thanks.
